title: Capacity activation cadence and utilization scenarios by region
body:
Purpose:
Quick-reference operational sheet for staged GPU activations across NA, EU, APAC with explicit utilization scenarios (conservative / target / aggressive) and sprint-aligned rollout cadence. This is intended for planning syncs with Platform, SRE, and Procurement.

Executive summary:
- Target window: Apr 2026 -> Jun 2027 (12+ month runway).
- Focus on diffusing risk: staggered activations by cloud region and provider to avoid simultaneous capacity pressure.
- Primary goal: maintain end-to-end token-level p95 latency SLO while moving to 70% steady utilization on new capacity within 6 weeks of activation (target scenario).

High-level capacity projections (vCPU/GPU-equivalent units rounded):
Columns: Region | Q2 2026 | Q3 2026 | Q4 2026 | Q1 2027 | Q2 2027
- NA: 120 A100 equiv | 240 | 360 | 520 | 680
- EU: 60 | 140 | 220 | 360 | 460
- APAC: 30 | 70 | 140 | 260 | 420
Assumptions: "A100 equiv" = baseline unit (H100 counted as 1.6x, L4 as 0.25x for throughput planning). Mixed tenancy expected on Dedicated lanes.

Utilization scenarios (by region) - percent of provisioned tokens used averaged over 7-day windows:
- Conservative: NA 35% | EU 30% | APAC 18%
- Target: NA 65% | EU 60% | APAC 55%
- Aggressive: NA 85% | EU 80% | APAC 75%
Note: target scenario assumes caching/ batching improvements from Optimize sprint 6.

Activation cadence (sprint-aligned):
- Sprint 2026-05 (Activation wave 1): NA zone-1 (us-west) + EU zone-1 (eu-central) -> +120 A100 equiv total. Focus: basic network, KMS, routing policies. Owner: Aisha.
- Sprint 2026-07 (Wave 2): NA zone-2 (us-east) + APAC zone-1 (ap-south) -> +140 A100 equiv. Add autoscaler tuning. Owner: Diego.
- Sprint 2026-10 (Wave 3): EU zone-2 + APAC zone-2 -> +220 A100 equiv. Focus: cross-region routing, DR rehearsals. Owner: Priya.
- Sprint 2027-02 (Wave 4): Global burst lanes + Dedicated customer pools -> +300 A100 equiv. Owner: Marco.
Each wave: 2-week smoke, 4-week ramp to target utilization, 2-week stabilization & rollback window.

Operational checkpoints (pre-activation):
- Procurement cleared (vendor contracts, ETAs) -> JIRA-ENGINF-2987.
- Network peering and egress budgeting signoff.
- KMS/HSM onboarding and key rotation policy (security).
- Load-testing templates (synthetic + live shadow).
- Observability hooks: token-level cost, kv-cache hit-rate, latency p50/p95.

Risk matrix (short):
- Supply delay -> mitigations: swap to alternative cloud vendor region, upsize H100 vs A100 in NA.
- Unexpected demand spike -> mitigations: throttle non-critical customers, enable fallback model variants, on-call escalation.
- Networking congestion -> mitigations: route diversification, stricter egress limits per route.

Open questions / TODOs:
- Confirm H100 wholesale pricing delta for Q3 reschedule. (Action: Procurement)
- Finalize Dedicated pool partitioning per enterprise customer (Action: Solutions Eng).
- Decide default safety-buffer across regions (10% vs 20%).

Metrics to track during ramp (every wave):
- Provisioned GPUs active / idle ratio (daily).
- 7-day avg utilization vs target.
- Model tail latency (95th/99th).
- KV cache hit-rate and prefix reuse.
- Cost per 1M tokens delivered by region.

Meeting cadence and owners:
- Weekly ops sync (Mon) - infra + SRE + Platform lead (owner: Marco).
- Biweekly procurement check-in (owner: Aisha).
- Post-wave retro + ops runbook updates (owner: Diego).

Appendix: quick ramp playbook (checklist)
- Day -14: confirm VM/GPU image + AMI bake, upload model artifacts to staging buckets, smoke test harness ready.
- Day 0: activate capacity, run basic health probes.
- Day 1-7: limited traffic (10-25%), measure latency and correctness.
- Day 8-28: progressive traffic increments to hit target utilization.
- Day 29-42: observe for regression, finalize autoscaler profiles, mark wave as completed.

Notes to reviewers: this sheet intentionally mixes conservative and target numbers to give options for procurement and sales conversations. Please add adjustments inline or drop comments.

References:
- linked artifacts above for confluence, jira, and GHPR.
- Related: capacity-activation-playbook (Confluence)
